title: desmodium glutinosum
intro: Desmodium glutinosum, commonly known as Stick-tight or Leucaena, is a perennial legume native to tropical and subtropical regions of the Americas. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Desmodium glutinosum include its ability to act as an antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and diuretic, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as hypertension, arthritis, and urinary tract infections. The bioactive constituents of Desmodium glutinosum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
